title: Historical RTEC applicant 'Reason Not Hired' code set
source_path: Affirmative Action Plan (AAP)/AA Applicant Log by Fiscal Year/Reason Not Hired Codes that go with applicant log.doc
usage_interpretation: This source is a coding key for historical applicant logs; it does not itself contain applicant identities.
Because historical applicant logs are restricted, generalized reporting should use only aggregate counts by disposition code when needed.
Code labels are historical wording and should not be assumed to match the current ATS or current approved disposition reasons.
currentness_questions: What disposition codes/reasons are currently used in ADP or the current applicant workflow?
Which current reasons map cleanly to these historical codes and which require a new taxonomy?
Are any current adverse-decision reasons governed by a separate background-check/adverse-action process?
